subject: DG1: Block dispatcher sessions from start_task (claim gate)
description: Enforce at POST /overlay/status when status=in_progress: resolve caller session_id, GET /session-info; if is_subagent=false return 409 'dispatcher sessions cannot claim tasks'. Reject force:true from dispatcher. Require session_id on claim body when not inferable from agent registry. Tests in test/endpoints.test.js.

summary: POST /overlay/status in_progress now resolves session_id (body or agent registry), rejects dispatcher/non-subagent sessions with 409 before claim apply (including force:true), and returns 400 when session_id is missing. Added dispatcher-gate tests in test/endpoints.test.js; all pass.
